items.title: Reaction Dynamics drops hybrid engine, plans medium-lift rocket
items.summary: Reaction Dynamics (RDX) is moving its rockets from hybrid to liquid-fuelled engines, the Longueuil, Que., company said Thursday, a switch it says will let its Aurora rocket carry more mass to orbit and streamline work on Borealis, its planned medium-lift launcher. RDX has dropped Aurora-1, the suborbital test flight it had planned from the Koonibba Test Range in South Australia, because the flight was designed to prove a hybrid engine that is no longer part of the company’s product plans.
